title: NNPC Reforms Credited with $15.33bn in Petroleum Sector Remittances
detail: The Arewa group has credited NNPC reforms with generating $15.33bn in remittances, claiming the petroleum sector overhaul is rewriting Nigeria's revenue history. The reform push under President Tinubu's administration has restructured NNPC's operations and financial reporting mechanisms, with the remittance figure cited as evidence of improved fiscal discipline in the oil sector.
